g.text: Reports spread and disappear from bounded local memory
Two fixed false claims originate from one Player; repeated transmissions are not independent observations.
All displayed reach/retention counts are identical across the 30 heldout seeds at each horizon; no error bars are omitted where variation exists.
Reach includes the two direct listeners. Retention queries actual ordinary + bounded consolidated stores, not ledger presence. Gossip and capacity changes had zero paired fill effects.
